description: Compute your weighted course grade from assignments, and test what-if scenarios.

faqs.a: Add each assignment with its name, score earned, max points and weight %. Weights should add up to 100%.
The weighted grade = Σ (score/max × weight). Each assignment contributes its fraction of the total proportionally to its weight.
faqs.q: How is the weighted grade calculated?

faqs.a: Type a hypothetical score into the What-if box and click Test — the grade updates without changing saved assignments.
faqs.q: How does the what-if tester work?

howto: Add assignments with score, max points and weight %.
Keep total weight at 100% for an accurate grade.
See your weighted grade and letter grade below.
Use the what-if tester to preview a score's effect.
